maturity_history.excerpt:
2021 年，公司面向客户 A 国产先进架构存储芯片制造工艺需求开发激光诱
导结晶设备（LIC）并于次年验证通过；2022 年，公司面向客户 C 先进制程存储
芯片制造工艺需求开发了激光诱导外延生长设备（LIEG）并于 2024 年验证通过；
2023 年公司面向先进制程逻辑芯片制造工艺需求开发了超浅结激光退火设备
（USJLA）并于 2024 年验证通过；2024 年公司面向先进制程逻辑芯片制造工艺
需求开发了动态表面合金设备（DALA）并于 2025 年验证通过；2024 年、2026
年公司面向三维集成电路制造需求分别开发了激光解键合设备、超薄键合晶圆激
光全切工艺设备并发往国内领先晶圆厂验证；2026 年，公司面向半导体先进制
程工艺需求开发了激光光罩修正工艺设备并发往国内领先晶圆厂验证；报告期
内发行人另有 LOW-K 晶圆激光开槽工艺设备、激光隐形划片工艺设备、激光辅
助键合工艺设备等多款前沿设备完成产业验证。
maturity_history.notes: '2021年，公司面向客户A国产先进架构存储芯片制造工艺需求开发激光诱导结晶设备（LIC）并于次年验证通过' -- developed 2021 for Customer A, validated 2022 (year only, no month/day stated).

maturity_history.excerpt:
1、激光热处理行业

  半导体制造工艺持续迭代，激光热处理设备逐渐成为先进半导体制造的必要
投资。公司是国内少数专注于半导体激光热处理设备的厂商，产品布局相对完整，
激光热处理设备的量产应用场景覆盖广度在国产设备厂商中居于领先地位。目前，
公司激光热处理设备产品已在存储芯片、逻辑芯片、功率器件和图像芯片产线量
产应用。

  公司原创性产品激光诱导结晶设备（LIC）可用于某国产先进架构先进制程
存储芯片创新工艺区域结晶，目前已批量交付客户 A 并用于量产；公司的激光
诱导外延生长设备（LIEG）用于先进制程存储芯片 SNC&BLC 结构中非晶硅的
孔洞消除及修复，目前已交付客户 C 并用于量产；公司的逻辑晶圆超浅结激光
退火设备（USJLA）已交付给客户 A、客户 B、客户 C、晶合集成以及其他境内
领先的晶圆代工厂等客户，设备已完成产业化验证并用于量产或相关厂商的工艺
maturity_history.notes: '目前已批量交付客户A并用于量产' -- delivered in batch to Customer A, used in volume production; single-customer claim.

Developed 2022 for an anonymised 'Customer C', validated 2024 (year only; p109/printed 1-1-108). Delivered to Customer C and used in volume production as of this prospectus (p150/printed 1-1-149: '目前已交付客户C并用于量产') -- a SINGLE-CUSTOMER volume claim. 'Customer C' is this filing's own anonymised, period-specific label and is NOT a persistent cross-filing identity: do not equate it with Yitang's unrelated anonymised 'EE' counterparty, or with any named firm such as CXMT, without independent evidence -- the base_die_thermal analysis-layer step report's own speculation that Customer C might be CXMT (its draft, line 300) is analyst conjecture about this filing, not something the filing itself states. Per the issuer, relaying Customer C's own reply (p156/printed 1-1-155): Customer C says it buys this tool type only from Laipu, and that globally only Korea's DIT (supplies only SK hynix) and EO Technics (supplies only Samsung) make similar tools, neither selling in China -- a company statement relaying an unverified customer reply, not independently corroborated; recorded here qualitatively rather than as a numeric observation. The same page gives a spec comparison (temperature ripple <5C vs a named competitor's <10C, peak temp 1390C vs 1350C, power 13.8kW vs 28.8kW) attributed to Laipu's own USJLA tool against 'Veeco (LSA101/LSA201)', not LIEG; preserved here in notes only, since the Atlas has no process-parameter metric for it and minting one is out of this packet's scope. Customer C also bought Laipu's USJLA logic-anneal tools (p150), so Customer C's registered overall spend (customer_sales/customer_sales_share, p162) is NOT attributable to LIEG alone. W13 RECORDS REVIEW (accept) by claude_w13_records_verifier: Name '激光诱导外延生长设备（LIEG）' and its row (application '先进制程DRAM存储芯片', stage '产业化应用') confirmed on p99 via -layout for row pairing and non-layout for contiguity, same method as LIC. category_id thermal_laser_anneal correct. Maturity chain (developed 2022, validated 2024, delivered to Customer C, volume_production) confirmed verbatim on p109/p150. The record is appropriately careful to flag that 'Customer C' is this filing's own anonymised label and explicitly declines to equate it with any named firm (e.g. CXMT) absent independent evidence -- correct discipline given the step-report speculation it cites is analyst conjecture, not a filing statement.
